method_card.objective: Query reaction-specific and enzyme-class annotations, documented assays and natural yeast parent identities.
method_card.mechanism: No input artifacts. Supply parameters taxid (integer 559292) and substrate (maltose, isomaltose, trehalose or lactose). Reads the same pinned S288C reaction, enzyme class and assay snapshots as yeast-archive-lookup@1; reports zero records only after a successful lookup.
method_card.estimator: S288C taxon filter; distinct accession, sequence version and digest. Exact reaction and EC links are separate. Count unique assay entries with single or grouped attribution. Retain unclear direction, substrate or undetermined activity.
method_card.training_data_lineage: Read-only Rhea 142, Swiss-Prot 2026_03, ENZYME 28-Jan-2026 and compiled BRENDA/SABIO-RK snapshots.

manifest.licence: GX archive reader; upstream sources retain their own terms.
manifest.licence_basis: Rhea and UniProt attribution; SIB ENZYME, BRENDA and SABIO-RK data remain on the licensed source deployment.
manifest.limitations: S. cerevisiae S288C only; four disaccharide archive queries. The target-specific observation depends on exact assay substrate and conditions. Class associations and records shared by multiple proteins cannot establish individual measured activity.
